|game_text=Plays on table. If an ‘insert’ card was just inserted or revealed, it is canceled. You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. While you occupy more battlegrounds than opponent, I Did It! is suspended.
|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 of [[You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III) (V)]] (version 2 of 5). The image here is the Players Committee card image of this version. The current text is [[You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every publication that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''Original''' ([[You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III) (V)]]): Slip in the PC's Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0), official text as of 1 August 2016<ref name="ms2016">Players Committee, Virtual Card Master Set (Set 0) PDF <code>Set-0.pdf</code>, “Official text as of August 1, 2016” (file created 2 August 2016), page 4, slip “•You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III) (V)” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 6 August 2016]).</ref>: “Plays on table. If an ‘insert’ card was just inserted or revealed, it is canceled. You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. While you occupy more battlegrounds than opponent, I Did It! is suspended.” Printed: a partial slip (the “DEFENSIVE SHIELD” band and the game-text box only), to be laid over the Decipher card; lower-left name “•You Cannot Hide Forever”; no errata mark. The PC first released this card with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014; the slips of that first release do not survive in the Internet Archive, so this sheet is the earliest surviving text. The PC re-issued the PDF on 30 May 2017 with this slip unchanged (pixel-identical)<ref name="ms2017">The same PDF re-issued by the PC (file created 30 May 2017), page 2 ([https://web.archive.org/web/20170704234722/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Internet Archive copy of 4 July 2017]).</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Card image published 8 July 2018<ref name="v1-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/022435b/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/youcannothideforever.gif youcannothideforever.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b 022435b] (8 July 2018, “Set 9 load”).</ref>: “Plays on table. If an ‘insert’ card was just inserted or revealed, it is canceled. You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. While you occupy more battlegrounds than opponent, I Did It! is suspended.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “•You Cannot Hide Forever”. The PC first released this shield with [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] on 24 September 2014. The PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018, so this is the earliest surviving PC card image; whether the 2014 release slip had the same words is not shown by it. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Same words as the slip above. This is the first PC card image of the card (the PC's Holotable image set starts on 8 July 2018): the whole card is drawn, with frame, picture and icons, instead of a print-and-cut slip. A visibly different publication, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 2)]]): Card image published 31 July 2022<ref name="v2-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ab74419/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/youcannothideforever.gif youcannothideforever.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/ab74419 ab74419] (31 July 2022, “updated hires gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Dark/hires/youcannothideforever.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/594c3a0 594c3a0] (31 July 2022, “Set 0 Hi Res”).</ref>: “Plays on table. If an ‘insert’ card was just inserted or revealed, it is canceled. You lose no Force to Boonta Eve Podrace. While you occupy more battlegrounds than opponent, I Did It! is suspended.” Printed: no errata mark; lower-left name “You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III)”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 2 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' re-rendered by the PC in its high-resolution card style (new frame, colours and typesetting); same words. The lower-left name changes from “•You Cannot Hide Forever” to “You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III)”. No errata mark.
* '''PC-E3''' ([[You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 3)]]): Card image published 22 July 2024<ref name="v3-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6c22b09/Images-HT/starwars/ResetDS-Dark/large/youcannothideforever.gif youcannothideforever.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6c22b09 6c22b09] (22 July 2024, “Fixing case and making gifs”); high-resolution image <code>ResetDS-Dark/hires/youcannothideforever.png</code>, commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a546b30 a546b30] (21 July 2024, “Set 23 Errata”).</ref>: “Plays on table. Cancels ‘insert’ cards just revealed. We'll Handle This may target only 5D6-RA-7 and Undercover spies. Unless Deep Hatred on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn.” Printed: marked “E1”; lower-left name “You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III)”. '''Errata mark:''' this image prints “E1” but is errata 3 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' PC errata released with [[Virtual Set 23]] and the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="dskit2024">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file built 2 August 2024), released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024).</ref> (image marked “E1”): the game text after “Plays on table.” is replaced: “Cancels ‘insert’ cards just revealed. We'll Handle This may target only 5D6-RA-7 and Undercover spies. Unless Deep Hatred on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn.” (the Boonta Eve Podrace and I Did It! sentences are removed).
* '''PC-E4''' ([[You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 4)]]): Partial slip in the July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit<ref name="dskit2024-slip">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF, 3 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, July 2024”; file created 2 August 2024), page 1: partial slip labelled “•You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III)”. Released with [[Virtual Set 23]] (22 July 2024); the PDF itself is dated by its creation date.</ref>: “Plays on table. Cancels ‘insert’ cards just revealed. We'll Handle This may target only 5D6-RA-7 and Undercover spies. Unless Deep Hatred on table, opponent may use only one combat card per turn.” '''Errata mark:''' this slip prints “E1” but is errata 4 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' Same words as the 22 July 2024 card image ([[You Cannot Hide Forever (Reflections III) (V) (Errata 2)]]). The kit prints the card as a partial slip — the “DEFENSIVE SHIELD” band and the game-text box only (no title, picture or lore) — with the lower-left name and the errata mark “E1” at the bottom, to be laid over a printed card. A separate PC publication that looks visibly different from the card image, so a version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication and every visible change is a version).
